description: Source code for 'git update-index' command, handling index updates, file permissions, and cache management.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Prints formatted messages if verbose mode is enabled.

methods.name: remove_test_directory
methods.description: Removes the temporary directory used for testing untracked cache support.

methods.name: get_mtime_path
methods.description: Constructs a path within the mtime test directory.

methods.name: xmkdir
methods.description: Creates a directory at the specified path within the mtime test directory.

methods.name: xstat_mtime_dir
methods.description: Gets the status of the mtime directory.

methods.name: create_file
methods.description: Creates a file at the specified path within the mtime test directory.

methods.name: xunlink
methods.description: Deletes a file at the specified path within the mtime test directory.

methods.name: xrmdir
methods.description: Removes a directory at the specified path within the mtime test directory.

methods.name: avoid_racy
methods.description: Sleeps for 1 second to avoid race conditions in mtime tests.

methods.name: test_if_untracked_cache_is_supported
methods.description: Tests if the filesystem supports untracked cache by performing various file operations and checking mtimes.

methods.name: mark_ce_flags
methods.description: Marks or unmarks cache entries with specific flags.

methods.name: remove_one_path
methods.description: Removes a path from the index if allowed.

methods.name: process_lstat_error
methods.description: Handles errors from lstat, removing missing files if appropriate.

methods.name: add_one_path
methods.description: Adds or updates a path in the index based on stat info.

methods.name: process_directory
methods.description: Handles directory paths, updating index entries accordingly.

methods.name: process_path
methods.description: Processes a filesystem path, adding or removing it from the index.

methods.name: add_cacheinfo
methods.description: Adds a cache entry with specified mode, object id, path, and stage.

methods.name: chmod_path
methods.description: Changes the executable permission of a path in the index.

methods.name: update_one
methods.description: Updates the index entry for a given path based on filesystem state and flags.

methods.name: read_index_info
methods.description: Reads index info lines from stdin and updates the index accordingly.

methods.name: read_one_ent
methods.description: Reads a single index entry from a tree object.

methods.name: unresolve_one
methods.description: Unresolves a path in the index, undoing merge stages.

methods.name: do_unresolve
methods.description: Unresolves multiple paths based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: do_reupdate
methods.description: Re-updates index entries that differ from HEAD.

methods.name: cmd_update_index
methods.description: Main function implementing 'git update-index' command, handling options, index locking, and updates.
